raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across six medical specialty categories, comparing a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) against six fine-tuned model variants. The horizontal axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and contains six categorical groups: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals. Within each group, seven bars are displayed side by side. The first bar, shown in light blue, represents the Mistralv0.2-Base model, while the remaining six bars represent models fine-tuned on each specialty: Cardio (light yellow), Gastro (light tan/peach), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (darker orange), Obstetrics (dark brown-orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across all six category groups, the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bar consistently reaches approximately -22, making it the tallest (closest to zero) bar in every group. The fine-tuned model bars are generally shorter, extending to values between approximately -24 and -26.5. Notably, in the Cardio group, the fine-tuned bars range from roughly -22.5 to -26.5, with the Cardio fine-tuned bar appearing around -22.5 and the Obstetrics and Pediatrics fine-tuned bars reaching down to approximately -26 to -26.5. In the Gastro group, the fine-tuned bars cluster between approximately -23.5 and -24.5. The Infect group shows fine-tuned bars ranging from about -22.5 to -24.5. The Neuro group displays fine-tuned bars between approximately -24 and -25. The Obstetrics group shows fine-tuned bars ranging from roughly -23 to -24.5, and the Pediatrics group has fine-tuned bars between approximately -23 and -24.5. The bars are not sorted by value within each group but follow a consistent ordering matching the legend sequence. No bars appear to be specially emphasized through outlining or annotation.
